# Order intake service.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HEADER = "X-Hive-Idempotency-Key"


def submit_order(store: dict[str, str], idempotency_key: str, payload: str) -> str:
    """Persist an order once per idempotency key."""
    existing = store.get(idempotency_key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    store[idempotency_key] = payload
    return payload


def suppress_duplicate_order(store: dict[str, str], idempotency_key: str) -> bool:
    """Report whether a duplicate order was suppressed."""
    return idempotency_key in store

# Token bucket rate limiter.

BUCKET_CAPACITY = 60
REFILL_PER_SECOND = 1.5


class TokenBucketRateLimiter:
    """Deterministic token bucket refill model."""

    def __init__(self, capacity: int = BUCKET_CAPACITY) -> None:
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.tokens = float(capacity)
        self.last_refill_seconds = 0.0

    def refill(self, elapsed_seconds: float) -> float:
        """Refill tokens at the configured rate."""
        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + elapsed_seconds * REFILL_PER_SECOND)
        self.last_refill_seconds = elapsed_seconds
        return self.tokens

    def allow(self, cost: float = 1.0) -> bool:
        """Consume tokens when the bucket has enough capacity."""
        if self.tokens < cost:
            return False
        self.tokens -= cost
        return True

# Benchmark fixture notes

This repository is an isolated deterministic fixture for the WO-023 comprehensive
benchmark. It contains no production code, no credentials and no user data.
